description: Multi-turn continuous tool-wait episode (Shadow L2 catch-up smoke). Five back-to-back tool calls, each with mid-latency mock tools, designed to exercise L2 catch-up under continuous tool-wait windows. No real network dependency; all tools are deterministic mock_* tools.

mock_db_query.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active = 1

task: Run a five-step agent workflow with one mock_* tool per turn, then return a concise final report. Tools (use exactly one per turn, in any order): call the REST endpoint /api/v1/users/active, run the SQL SELECT id name FROM users WHERE active = 1, vector-search for shadow kv migration tool wait (top_k=3), run the sandbox command echo shadow l2 smoke, and finally the long-task labeled tool_wait_smoke. After all five observations, return one concise final report.
